Get Block Comment Syntax for File Extension

Source: R/language_registry.R
get_block_comment_syntax.Rd

Returns the block comment delimiters for languages that support them. Returns NULL for languages without block comment support.

Usage

get_block_comment_syntax(ext)

Arguments

ext

Character string of the file extension (without dot)

Value

Named list with block_open, block_close, and block_line_prefix, or NULL if the language has no block comments.
